review_notes: Corrected: the target head of סֹלֶת → of fine flour moves from flour to fine. Rule 31's subtraction test heads an adjective-plus-generic phrase on the modifier (dry land → dry, high place → high, burnt offerings → burnt), and its class-noun tie-break requires the bare noun in the verse, in the passage, or as the ordinary rendering of the word before you — the ASV writes no bare flour here and always renders סֹלֶת fine flour.
